types.name: Single row
types.description: People sit or stand in one straight line facing north or south (or some each way), and clues say "third to the left", "at an extreme end", "between".

types.name: Two parallel rows
types.description: People sit in two rows that face each other (for example one row facing north, the other south), and clues say who "faces" whom.

types.name: Circle facing the centre
types.description: People sit around a circular table or stand in a circle, all facing the centre, and you find neighbours, opposites or "second to the right".

types.name: Circle facing outside or mixed
types.description: People sit around a circle with their backs to the centre (facing outside), or some face the centre and some face outside.

types.name: Square or rectangular table
types.description: People sit at the corners and/or the middle of the sides of a square, rectangular or other polygon-shaped table.

types.name: Floors of a building
types.description: People live on different floors of a building (ground or lowest floor numbered 1), with clues like "two floors above" or "lives below".

types.name: Days, months or order of events
types.description: Events, exams or meetings fall on different days of a week, months or dates, with clues like "only one person between A and B".

types.name: Matching people to attributes
types.description: Each person is matched to two or more details (city, colour, job, subject) from a list of clues, and you fill a grid with no seating order.

types.name: Comparisons and inequalities
types.description: People or things are compared by height, weight, age or marks ("taller than", "heavier than"), or letters are joined by signs like >, <, ≥, = and you check conclusions.
